title: Silhouette nke Africa, akara mmepụta na grading

say: Silhouette nke Africa, akara mmepụta na grading.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka modul anọ nke Advanced Tailoring and Pattern Ime.
Ị ga-edepụta iro na buba, kaftan na boubous, wee gbakọọ ákwà tupu ịzụrụ.

say: Kimono-cut buba bụ T-ọdịdị, na-ebipụ aka uwe n'ime otu na ahụ. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Yetunde na Abeokuta na-esepụta ihe maka onye ahịa nwere bọt 104 cm. Ọ na-ahọrọ 20 cm nke ịdị mfe, ya mere, nkeji nke ọ bụla bụ 31 cm n'ogo bust.

panel.heading: Yetunde kpụrụ a buba na iro
items: Bust 104 + 20 mfe, ÷ 4 = 31 cm otu ụzọ n'ụzọ anọ
Nyocha hip: (112 + 8) ÷ 4 = 30 cm, ọ dị mma
Oghere dị nso: 10 cm n'obosara
Iro: eriri ukwu 4 cm, 25 cm n'ihu machie
nko na mmanya ka ọ nọrọ maka ịgba egwu

say: Ọ na-enyocha hip: 112 gbakwunyere 8, kewara 4, chọrọ 30 cm. Ahịrị akụkụ ya dị 31 cm zuru ezu, yabụ n'akụkụ ọnụ ya na-agba ọsọ.

say: A na-ewu boubou site na akụkụ anọ apịaji n'ubu, na-agbatị nkwojiaka ruo nkwojiaka. Lelee obosara ákwà mbụ. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Hadiza dị na Kano nwere onye ahịa nwere ogwe aka nke 158 cm, mana akwa ya dị naanị 116 cm n'obosara.

panel.heading: Hadiza na-akwado boubou
items: Ogologo ogwe aka 158 cm, akwa 116 cm n'obosara
Shortfall 42 cm: akụkụ abụọ n'akụkụ
Ogologo: 2 × 138 + hems = 282 cm
Mkpokọta: 564 cm, ihe dịka 5.64 m
Yards 6 dị mkpụmkpụ, yabụ zụta 7 yad

say: Mkpebi ahụ bụ 42 cm, yabụ ọ na-agbakwunye akụkụ abụọ nke symmetrical, nke ọ bụla 24 cm n'obosara nwere ikike mkpuchi.

say: Icheta. Ọ dị mfe na akụkụ dị n'okpuru na-akpụzi buba. Lelee obosara ákwà ma jiri nlezianya tụgharịa yad. Iberibe akwụ naanị na akwa na-enweghị ụra.
Chekwa agụba ọ bụla, ma nwalee nha akara akara kacha ukwuu.

panel.heading: Cheta

Iberibe akwụkwụ naanị mgbe enweghị ụra
Chebe agụba ọ bụla; ebipụ gị
Ogo site na eserese nha gị, nwalee nke kachasị

say: Ugbu a depụta buba na iro, hazie boubou na akwa ya, tulee akara abụọ, ma mee ọkwa otu ụkpụrụ nha atọ.
Gaa n'ihu na nkuzi ndị dị n'okpuru.
